Please tell me:
1. Which contractor do you mean? (Name and email address)
2. What do you mean by “reconnected”? (Examples: re-enable their company account, restore VPN access, reactivate network access, restore access to a specific app/project)
3. Who should I contact to do the reconnection? (IT support contact, contractor directly, or someone else — include email/phone if you want me to reach them)
4. Any important context or constraints? (e.g., contractor ID, ticket/incident number, whether MFA reset is allowed, deadline/timezone)
5. Do you want me to:
   - Draft an email for you to review first, or
   - Send the email now on your behalf?

If you want me to send it now, confirm that I should send from your account me@company.com and provide the recipient(s) and any CC/BCC to include. If you prefer, I can also search your mailbox for prior threads or tickets about this contractor before contacting anyone. Which would you like me to do?
